channel.title: Fedora CI on Packit Service Status

item.title: [Resolved] No pull-request statuses from Packit Fedora CI
item.description: Packit is getting 403 Forbidden errors from src.fedoraproject.org API when attempting to update check statuses. As a result, there are no Fedora CI statuses on pull requests even though the jobs are running and you can find them at https://dashboard.packit.dev/jobs/koji and https://dashboard.packit.dev/jobs/testing-farm. The corresponding API endpoint was unblocked and everything should be back to normal.
item.content:
Packit is getting 403 Forbidden errors from src.fedoraproject.org API when attempting to update check statuses. As a result, there are no Fedora CI statuses on pull requests even though the jobs are running and you can find them at https://dashboard.packit.dev/jobs/koji and https://dashboard.packit.dev/jobs/testing-farm.

The corresponding API endpoint was unblocked and everything should be back to normal.
